lessons: Respect big early-season line moves. lessons.title: Trust my own judgement; markets are an input, not the answer.
lessons.body: (User directive 2026-10-21.) Don't flip a pick just because the line moved. But when I can name the reason for a sharp move (a real roster hole like no center, or a key returnee confirmed), move my own number by that amount; don't just keep the pick at lower confidence. Only when I can't find a reason do I keep the pick at slightly lower confidence. (2026-10-22: UTA with no center vs Edey lost by 20; SAC-LAC lost by 25. lessons.title: Grade the players who are left, not departures or the injury count, on both sides, and verify the final injury report for anyone my thesis depends on.
lessons.body: (2026-10-25: I had HOU's Sheppard out; he played and hit five threes, and deep HOU won without VanVleet and Adams. 2026-10-21: OKC and PHI benches. 2026-10-22: LAC "missing five" won by 25 behind Garland/Lopez/Wagler; CHA missing three starters still won with Reid/Schröder/Allen.)

lessons.title: A total's line move is an input, not an automatic pass.
lessons.body: When the move goes against my lean, re-check my named reasons (pace, shooting, rest, first games); if they hold, take the lean at the better moved number, smaller size. Record of following the move: 2-2 (BOS-DET and CHA-BKN moves were right; 2026-10-23 both totals rose 4-5 points and went Under by 17.5 and 56.5, and I passed on a stated Under lean in CLE-PHI). Two first-week games on 2026-10-23 landed far below the line; don't assume shootouts in openers.

lessons.title: Dogs with points: need real edge, but don't build rules off one night.
lessons.body: My dogs-with-points are 2-4, so require ~3.5-4 points of edge on my own margin (not 5+) and size small. The 5+ bar came from one 9-2 favorites night (2026-10-22) and cost three winners on 2026-10-24 (LAC, MEM, SAC covered; favorites went 4-8 ATS). Still respect a clearly better, healthier roster and a team's first real game.

lessons.title: Achilles/ACL returnees: no night-one penalty by default.
lessons.body: Tatum went 6-23 in game one, then 36 in game two; Haliburton, Lillard, Kyrie and VanVleet have been fine. Judge each on preseason form and minutes.

lessons.title: Weight a single game lightly, in both directions, but respect a multi-game trend.
lessons.body: CHI, DAL, IND and SAC reversed their openers on 2026-10-24; CHA bounced back from 81 points to beat MIA on 2026-10-25. But CHI's 23% three-point shooting over three games is a trend, and a rest edge didn't overcome it (lost to WSH on 2026-10-25).

lessons.title: For a questionable star, also ask what decides the game if he plays.
lessons.body: Trimmed SAS for Fox; he played, and HOU's size and free throws (28-31) won it.
